abstract: Monitors industrial discharge licenses and downstream purification washwater volumes
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENV). The Environmental compliance officer (ENV) oversees industrial discharge compliance and biomanufacturing wastewater metrics, specifically tracking on-site industrial wastewater discharge permit endorsements and downstream purification washwater volumes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: including clean-in-place pre-rinse volumes·Monitors industrial discharge licenses and downstream purification washwater volumes（SUST）
information_points.content:
ENV-SUST-1XT：BioCork Advanced Biologics Campus maintains an active on-site industrial wastewater discharge permit endorsement under its EPA industrial effluent discharge license. On an accounting basis including clean-in-place pre-rinse volumes, its downstream purification rinse volume is 110 m3 per campaign.
ENV-SUST-WZB：Shannon Bioprocess Manufacturing Center does not hold an on-site industrial wastewater discharge permit endorsement. When evaluated including clean-in-place pre-rinse volumes, its downstream purification rinse volume is 70 m3 per campaign.
ENV-SUST-RE1：Ringaskiddy Cell Therapeutics Facility possesses an approved on-site industrial wastewater discharge permit endorsement. Its downstream purification rinse volume is recorded at 90 m3 per campaign under the basis including clean-in-place pre-rinse volumes.

information_points.title: excluding clean-in-place pre-rinse volumes·Monitors industrial discharge licenses and downstream purification washwater volumes（RECYC）
information_points.content:
ENV-RECYC-QPQ：BioCork Advanced Biologics Campus holds a verified on-site industrial wastewater discharge permit endorsement. Measured on a basis excluding clean-in-place pre-rinse volumes, its downstream purification rinse volume is 70 m3 per campaign.
ENV-RECYC-GGT：Shannon Bioprocess Manufacturing Center lacks an on-site industrial wastewater discharge permit endorsement. On an accounting basis excluding clean-in-place pre-rinse volumes, its downstream purification rinse volume stands at 70 m3 per campaign.
ENV-RECYC-T7W：Ringaskiddy Cell Therapeutics Facility maintains an active on-site industrial wastewater discharge permit endorsement. Accounting for effluent excluding clean-in-place pre-rinse volumes, its downstream purification rinse volume is 90 m3 per campaign.
